apiServer.title: API server
apiServer.description: Serves the model loaded in this app over HTTP, so other devices on the same Wi-Fi can use it — OpenAI-compatible endpoints plus a small chat page in the browser. Keep the app open while it is in use.
apiServer.noAddressRunning: No LAN IPv4 address found — is Wi-Fi connected?
apiServer.noAddressStopped: Turn the server on to see its address
apiServer.clientHint: Point any OpenAI-compatible client at {{baseUrl}} with any API key string.
apiServer.noModel: No model loaded — requests will answer 503

keepAlive.title: Keep running
keepAlive.screenOffTitle: Keep running with the screen off
keepAlive.screenOffDescription: Holds a partial wake lock, a high-performance Wi-Fi lock and a foreground service so inference and the API server keep working when the screen turns off or the app is in the background. Shows a notification while active.
keepAlive.batteryAllowed: Doze will not freeze the app.
keepAlive.batteryBlocked: Doze may still freeze the app after the screen is off.
